function.name: share_artifact
function.description: Share one of your own binary artifacts with another agent on this platform. The platform picks the shortest safe transport automatically: when both you and the recipient run directly on the same Evonic host it returns a host-local absolute path ("transport":"local_path"); in every other case (sandbox, bwrap, remote, tunnel, or unknown) it returns a short-lived, single-use tokenized HTTPS download URL ("transport":"token_url") plus the file's size and SHA-256. The recipient copies the file into its own workspace and MUST verify the SHA-256 before use. Never paste binary content or base64 data into a message — use this tool instead. On a local_path result: copy the file into your configured workspace immediately, verify the SHA-256, and never forward the path to a third party. On a token_url result: download the URL once (it is single-use and expires in ~5 minutes) and verify the SHA-256.

filename.description: The exact name of the artifact file to share, as it appears in your artifact directory (a plain basename such as "report.pdf" — no directory separators).

recipient_agent_id.description: The ID of the recipient agent (lowercase snake_case), e.g. "linus".
